document_status: operator-design-baseline; architectural goal; prototype behavior disclosed separately
corpus_role: A machine-readable statement of the intended end-user experience for Victor, not a claim of completed native implementation.
operator_goal: Use one Oracyl Android application as a coherent, low-friction command center for Victor across phone portrait and desktop/Samsung DeX. Preserve the approved visual aesthetics and navigation while supplying real capability bindings later.

Chats.goal: Converse directly with Victor and resume saved threads without losing context.

Research.goal: Run, inspect, continue, and retrieve Victor research work, with findings, sources, and status preserved.

Tasks.goal: Create, monitor, review, and manage scheduled or bounded work.

Apps.goal: Launch purposeful applications hosted within Oracyl without leaving the primary workspace.

Tabs.goal: Reopen browser pages or in-app content tabs; maintain a Chromium-like optional browsing workspace inside Oracyl.

Projects.goal: Organize work into persistent project workspaces with relevant conversations, files, research, and tasks.

Skills.goal: Discover, review, and invoke Victor capabilities/skills without conflating them with hosted Apps.

Accounts.goal: Connect, view, and manage identities/integrations and the permissions attached to them.

pinned.purpose: Quick-access shortcuts to any supported underlying resource type, independent of its category and not duplicating its data.
pinned.display_policy: mixed icon + item name; retain stable link to original resource

recent_chats.purpose: Resume latest conversations quickly; list should scroll and never force important actions off-screen.

tabs.checkmark_semantics: save tab in Tabs sidebar category; it is not a claim that the web URL was permanently bookmarked by browser engine
tabs.separate_pin_semantics: Pinned shortcuts may reference a saved or open tab; no coupling mandated.

desktop_dex.viewport_purpose: canonical desktop/DeX reference; adapt while preserving hierarchy
desktop_dex.presentation: full-height app surface, integrated top tab rail, persistent sidebar, conversation canvas and bottom composer
required: primary Oracyl tab is leftmost and non-closable
secondary tabs have save/checkmark and X
main nav is in exact order
Pinned and Recent Chats displayed below nav
Library and Settings anchored in sidebar footer
no OS taskbar or full browser address bar built into app UI
desktop_dex.reference_notes: Screenshot reference was browser-rendered at CSS 1920x1080; real Android DeX host window controls are controlled by the host.

phone_portrait.presentation: single-column chat with drawer overlay, compact toolbar, fixed bottom composer, settings page accessible via drawer
required: real Android OS owns status/navigation bars; no fake duplicate bars in a native host
hamburger opens drawer, scrim and back close
new-chat action present at top and drawer
navigation shows same eight categories, each expandable
Pinned and Recent Chats available in drawer
Library and Settings in drawer footer
chat input reachable with Android keyboard and safe-area insets
no desktop tab rail forced into portrait
phone_portrait.reference_notes: Portrait screenshot is 720x1560 physical PNG pixels generated from 360x780 CSS pixel viewport at scale factor 2. Screenshot references are web preview captures, not Android hardware certification.

settings.role: accessible app settings, grouped into dark rounded cards in phone mode; desktop entry appears in footer

design.theme: dark-only canonical reference unless Operator authorizes change

logo.identity: purple/near-black yin-yang; upper dot circular, lower comma with distinct curved tail
logo.must_not: generic yin-yang with two round dots; textual punctuation glyph; unrelated mark

design.no_artistic_freedom: Visual changes require Operator approval. When reference image and source differ, flag the conflict instead of silently choosing a redesign.
design.note: Numbers are source-derived CSS reference values and viewport-specific; do not present them as exact physical device pixels.

prototype_already_demonstrated: desktop tab strip and checkmark UI state
desktop expandable sidebar and context pin/unpin demo
phone drawer open/close and expandable menu
same canonical SVG logo at prescribed locations
prototype_only_not_done: real Chromium tab engine and page navigation
capabilities.do_not_misrepresent: A decorative/clickable control or local preview does not satisfy the underlying feature until connected, exercised, and accepted.

principles.implementation_choices: Victor may implement via Android WebView, native Compose, or hybrid provided the user-facing output and behavior satisfy the same contracts. UI aesthetics are fixed; implementation mechanisms may vary without changing user-observable results.
principles.android_deployment: One Android application; same logical Oracyl workspace and data across handheld phone and Samsung DeX/windowed use. Responsive state not two unrelated products.
principles.primary_navigation: Top-level category order immutable unless Operator explicitly approves change.
principles.principal_app_tab: Oracyl is always first, cannot be closed; it is the app surface, not merely a website in a desktop browser.
principles.web_host: Chromium-compatible browser capability is optional in-app; other browser tabs can be closed. Save/checkmark adds the tab to Tabs; separate Pinned shortcuts are optional and can reference browser tabs.
principles.skills_vs_apps: Apps are interactive in-app workspaces. Skills are reusable capabilities or procedures exposed to Victor. A Skill is not automatically an App.
principles.data_model: IDs and shared repository pointers underlie entries in sidebar, Pinned, Tabs, Recents; list placements reference one underlying item rather than duplicate data.
principles.cross_mode: Switching orientation or DeX must preserve the active workspace, text draft where feasible, selected tab, scroll context, pin state, and settings, with platform lifecycle recovery.
principles.authority: User controls aesthetic canon, integrations, external actions, and permissions. Design pack grants no autonomy or credentials; no kernel surgery follows from these UI instructions.
principles.security: Render untrusted browser content in isolated web surface; no arbitrary JS bridge to privileged Victor actions. Handle attachments through permissions-scoped picker. Protect account credentials with platform security. Require permission before microphone or any external operation.
principles.accessibility: Maintain screen reader labels, keyboard focus, touch targets, contrast and reduced-motion path; preserve visual geometry where feasible without sacrificing operating-system accessibility settings.
principles.failure_semantics: Clearly indicate disconnected/offline/not implemented states; do not fabricate saved state or successful external actions.

non_goals: No new AI model training is implied by the UI corpus
No disclosure of Operator identity or credentials
No graphical charts are required by this UI reference
No claim that an HTML prototype is itself a shipped Android APK
